race.comment: HIGHVIEW SADLER NZ (3) finished fourth last start over 1780m at this track, beaten 7 metres, after a modest sixth at Albion Park the run prior. Will enjoy a nice run from this favourable starting position. Big chance if things go his way. TAKE COURAGE (4) was in the money at this track two runs ago before having her colours lowered at her latest appearance over 1780m at this track, beaten 12 metres. This should be an easier assignment so she is in the right race to return to form. LOVIN MISS DIXIE (2) resumes. Last appeared when a modest seventh over 1780m at this track 12 weeks ago. OUR DOLLY (1) disappointed last time when seventh over 2138m at Albion Park. Can turn things around.
